notes:
Summary: Prospect is a clinical search platform used by integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and outpatient clinics. Strong PHI controls required; team wants private deployment with per-request auditability and an auditable BAA. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking pipeline to power clinician-facing search and chart summarization.

Key quotes / signals: "We need sub-second p99 for clinician workflows — anything >200ms feels slow to doctors." — Head of Platform.
"Cannot have any PHI leave customer VPC; we will require private peering or on-prem option for initial rollouts."

Risk profile: High compliance bar (HIPAA + ISO), multiple EU clinics mean potential residency requirements, procurement cycle long (security + legal). IT procurement has dedicated cloud-connect team; expect network approvals before pilot infra spins up.

Why Redwood: Liked unified runtime story (hosted -> private parity) and quantization/re-ranking guidance in the docs. Interested in Optimize recommendations to reduce per-query cost across large indexes.

Commercial: Target ARR band feels like $300-750k given enterprise rollout timelines; procurement expects a proof-of-concept (3-month) followed by phased rollout.

Conversation notes (shorthand):
- Feb 22 call (ff:call_2026-02-22_peregrine_prod_discussion): Introduced Redwood Dedicated vs Private; walked through POC topology (VPC + DMZ + HSM).
- Feb 28: Security team requested BAA draft and detailed audit log examples (drive link).
- Mar 03: SE workshop with Jordan — reviewed index plan: ~120M docs, top-k rerank (k=50), semantic embeddings + lexical hybrid.
- Mar 08: Pricing sensitivity — aiming for <$0.03/query average across queries after batching/caching.

Short-term asks: BAA template, per-query cost sensitivity model, sample infra bill for 3-month POC (dedicated pool + KV cache), sample audit log payloads and retention model.

Long-term asks: Multi-region residency, HSM-backed key management, per-token cost breakdown + tooling to monitor drift in reranker quality.

use_case_summary: Use-case: clinician-facing retrieval augmented generation for chart search and point-of-care summarization. Pipeline: ingest structured and unstructured notes -> dense embeddings store -> candidate retrieval -> transformer-based reranker -> short answer/generation. Requirements: low p99 latency for reranker (<200ms target), index scale ~100-150M docs, per-query cost goal <$0.03 after batching, strict PHI controls and end-to-end auditability.
